systems.system: plateforme numérique de gestion du casier judiciaire national
systems.tiers: planned under the justice sector policy letter 2025-2029 (adopted 29 July 2025), to automate and centralise procedures now on paper registers

note: Justice ministry plan: a criminal-record platform and electronic case management in the courts. Nothing on police or gendarmerie station records, and no link to a police system stated.
